label: TP
reason: Alert 1 (path-injection) alert-TP: User-controlled 'seg' parameter flows directly to redirect URL sink at line 24. Resolved sink value = "https://{host}/{seg}" where seg = request.getParameter("seg") or "home". The path segment is never sanitized or validated, allowing open redirect attack vectors. Host regex validates domain but not path content.

evidence.note: User input 'seg' from request.getParameter('seg') flows directly to redirect URL without sanitization
